context: A uni student helps a teen friend plan a winter day in the city
purpose: Teach: 池袋/前方/ブロード/ゴールド/シルバー/サンタ/ニート/登校

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ先輩、冬休みに池袋で遊びたいんだけど、どこ行けばいい？
lines.en: Hey senpai, I wanna hang out in Ikebukuro during winter break, where should I go?
lines.style: Bright teenage voice, slightly pleading and excited tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 池袋ね。電車乗るなら前方の車両に乗ると東口に近いよ。サンシャイン通り抜けるのが定番かな。
lines.en: Ikebukuro, huh. If you take the train, ride the front car—it's closer to the east exit. Walking through Sunshine Street is the classic route.
lines.style: Calm older student voice, knowledgeable and helpful in delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: クリスマス前だからサンタの飾りいっぱいあるよね？写真撮りたい！
lines.en: It's before Christmas so there's lots of Santa decorations, right? I wanna take photos!
lines.style: Excited girlish enthusiasm, rising intonation throughout the line.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あるよ。今年はゴールド系のイルミがメインで、去年のシルバーとはまた雰囲気違ってけっこう綺麗。
lines.en: Yeah. This year it's mainly gold-themed illuminations—a different vibe from last year's silver, and quite pretty.
lines.style: Warm reassuring tone, painting a scene with gentle pacing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うわー見たい！あ、でも私、最近学校休みがちで、登校する日もダルくてさ…
lines.en: Wow, I wanna see! Ah, but lately I've been skipping school, even going feels exhausting...
lines.style: Tone drops, voice trails off into embarrassed mumbling.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: おいおい、このまま卒業後ニートになったらシャレにならないぞ。遊ぶのはいいけど、登校もちゃんとしなよ。
lines.en: Hey hey, if you end up a NEET after graduation it won't be a joke. Fun's fine, but actually show up to school too.
lines.style: Half-joking but firm, gentle scolding with affectionate undertone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: わかってるって！じゃあ途中でカフェ寄りたい。ブロードウェイ近くで落ち着けるとこ知らない？
lines.en: I know, I know! Then I wanna stop at a cafe on the way. Know somewhere chill near Broadway?
lines.style: Quickly changing subject, defensive then enthusiastic shift.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 中野ブロードウェイは別の駅だよ…まあ池袋にも静かなカフェあるから、計画立てて当日一緒にまわろっか。
lines.en: Nakano Broadway is a different station... well, Ikebukuro has quiet cafes too. Let's plan it out and walk around together that day.
lines.style: Slightly amused correcting tone, then settling into friendly warmth.
